Origin and meaning

Sandra is a Greek name meaning “defender of the people (short form of Alexandra)”.

About the name Sandra

A short form of Alexandra that was a top pick in the 1940s.

The name Sandra suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
